_comment: Walkersville HS boys soccer history. Seasons 1928-2019 come from Spencer Shortt’s history PDF (lionssoccer.org, Jan 2020); 2020-2025 from ArbiterLive, walkersvillelions.com, lionssoccer.org and MaxPreps. Edit by hand, then run scripts/history.py. Game scores are Walkersville first. est: score unknown, recorded by the PDF as 1-0/0-1/0-0. pk: result after penalty kicks.

coaches.note: Played on the 1975 state finalist and 1976 county champion teams.

coaches.note: Class of 2014. Four-year varsity player and two-time captain; scored 4 goals in a game in 2013.

seasons.story: “One of the highlights of 1928 was when the WHS soccer team won the State Championship.” From a letter to Charles A. Nicodemus (class of 1947) about the school’s first graduating class, 1929.

notes: No records, rosters or photos have been found for 1929–1937.
The PDF’s honors page lists the 1945 county and division titles; the 1946 season page carries them. Shown here on 1946.
The PDF marks 1947 “Champions?”: a title is rumored but unconfirmed.
Team photo lists Tom Ford as head coach.

school_records: Most Goals in a Game (at the time): 4 — Brad Grimes
Most Shutouts in a Season: 7 — David Remsberg
seasons.story: State champions: an 11-1-3 season and 38 goals scored, with seven shutouts from keeper David Remsberg. Brad Grimes set the single-game scoring record with four.
Region champions and state finalists, falling 2-1 to St. Michael’s in the final.

seasons.story: A .500 regular season turned into a run to the state final. The 52 goals scored is still the team record; Jeff Shriver scored 15 seconds into one game.
